title: Customers reporting skin darkening and poor product quality
situation: Customers are reporting adverse skin reactions to a skincare product, which poses a health and safety risk requiring immediate attention.

params.note: Multiple reports of skin darkening and poor quality for skincare products. Potential safety issue.

actions.why: Safety concerns regarding product ingredients require expert review by the Trust and Safety team.

params.reply_en: We are concerned to hear about your experience. Please stop using the product immediately while we investigate this with our quality team. We will contact you shortly with next steps.
params.reply_ar: نأسف لسماع ذلك. يرجى التوقف عن استخدام المنتج فوراً بينما نقوم بالتحقق من الأمر مع فريق الجودة. سنتواصل معك قريباً لإبلاغك بالخطوات التالية.

actions.why: Acknowledge the safety concern and advise immediate cessation of use.

reply_en: We are concerned to hear about your experience. Please stop using the product immediately while we investigate this with our quality team. We will contact you shortly with next steps.
reply_ar: نأسف لسماع ذلك. يرجى التوقف عن استخدام المنتج فوراً بينما نقوم بالتحقق من الأمر مع فريق الجودة. سنتواصل معك قريباً لإبلاغك بالخطوات التالية.

reply_other.es: Lamentamos escuchar sobre su experiencia. Por favor, deje de usar el producto inmediatamente mientras investigamos esto con nuestro equipo de calidad. Nos pondremos en contacto con usted pronto con los siguientes pasos.

alternatives.hypothesis: Counterfeit or expired batch in circulation
alternatives.why: Reports of quality issues could stem from a compromised supply chain batch.
Customers may feel the product does not match the advertised benefits.
